summary: In his final decade, L. Ron Hubbard covertly took over Clearwater, Florida, directed Scientology's infiltration of the US government and harassment of critics, made abusive vanity films while hiding from the law, and died in seclusion in California in 1986.

evidence.note: host frames the two parts as the last ten years of Hubbard's life, after a separate three-part biography
1975: Hubbard comes ashore in Florida and launches the plan to make Clearwater a Scientology capital
front companies buy downtown landmarks for cash; real-estate takeover of the town
Guardian's Office campaign to unseat the mayor, including a staged hit-and-run in Washington
Snow White traced back to 1973; agents inside the IRS, Coast Guard and DEA by 1975
author of a 1972 critical book framed for bomb threats and harassed for years
son Quentin's 1976 suicide and the church's seizure of his medical records
1977 FBI raid; Mary Sue Hubbard and others convicted, Hubbard an unindicted co-conspirator
coda on later deaths at Flag Land Base and the church's current hold on downtown Clearwater
church film studio set up; long segment on Hubbard as an abusive director
church buys Battlefield Earth copies in bulk and funds a PR push to make it a hit
January 1986 death in seclusion; coroner findings and the church's announcement

notes: partial_life set: the title and the host frame this as the last decade of Hubbard's life, a sequel to a separate biography; earlier life gets only callbacks. covered_span starts 1973 for the Snow White origin and the Cooper framing; Clearwater coda (~4 min) sets reaches_present. electoral-politics (mayor) and finance-crypto (property takeover) are loose fits. Subdivisions empty: FL, DC, CA and NV all matter.
